summary: 28 features and 4 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • pi: add response segments usage and timestamp tracking (b1ba290)
  • grains: inject retry configuration into executor requests (23b9a87)
  • orleans: integrate retry lifecycle into executor stream adapters (282ad89)
  • retry: add Pi CLI retry infrastructure and execution snapshot support (a9309b2)
  • pi: add Pi CLI configuration to appsettings (19eb493)
  • pi: add Pi CLI to system configuration (768fe52)
  • pi: add Pi CLI hero provider configuration (b2a75c5)
  • pi: add Pi CLI monitoring and profession catalog (6cb79c9)
  • pi: add Pi CLI grain factory routing (2878fda)
  • pi: add Pi CLI provider factory integration (6d0c2ce)
  • pi: add Pi CLI provider type and infrastructure (2369bed)
  • pi: add Pi CLI provider core implementation (a6ed51d)
  • ai: add Reasonix CLI provider integration (205380a)
  • prompt-loader: add runtime override prompts path support (cb53cef)
  • autotask: remove github-about-optimization custom executor (76d44b0)

HagiCode-org/web

  • types: add CLI key normalization and extend supported executors (39569c8)
  • executor: add Pi CLI hero integration (26c1988)
  • flow: add enabled toggle for CLI retry overrides (3d6ae37)
  • health: update health monitoring with detailed tracking (e360bab)
  • theme: add preview mode to theme selection dialog (aba80c8)
  • executor: add Reasonix executor support (ffdf861)
  • i18n: add confirmation step to language selection dialog (a1821f9)
  • theme: add vacation theme support to theme system and components (feb50a6)
  • theme: add vacation theme with icecream and firefly icons (d887dc6)
  • i18n: add LanguageSelectDialog and extract language switcher (d1acc00)
  • session: add SessionProfilePickerPanel and integrate with session components (bc41135)
  • ui: add InlineHelpTooltip component (83a6c20)
  • ui-master: add compact preview variant for command summary (3bcfbbd)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • retry: preserve zero retry CLI overrides in normalized snapshot (fba5ce1)

HagiCode-org/web

  • theme: add vacation theme support to theme toggle and driver (02b2a50)
  • components: update profession filter and path reference picker dependencies (eebe392)
  • ui: handle path reference picker state update order correctly (c0cdee5)
